overview: The Medford Zoning Board of Appeals reviewed four applications, granting variances for a mixed-use development on Salem Street and a residential fence, while continuing applications for used car sales on Harvard Avenue and a single-family home on Windsor Road.

items.title: 290 Salem Street
items.summary: Approved variances for insufficient front and side yard setbacks, lot coverage, lot area, and residential density to allow construction of a seven-unit mixed-use residential building with ground-floor commercial space.

items.title: 121 Third Street (Winthrop Street fence)
items.summary: Approved a variance permitting a four-foot fence along the sidewalk, subject to the condition that the corner at the intersection be blunted back at least eight feet in both directions for vehicle visibility.

items.title: 38 Harvard Avenue
items.summary: Continued to April 25, 2024, an application to permit Class 2 used motor vehicle sales at an existing repair shop in order to consult with KP Law regarding discrepancies between the advertised variance notice and relief sought as a pre-existing non-conforming use finding.

items.title: 0 Windsor Road
items.summary: Continued to April 25, 2024, an application for dimensional variances to build a single-family house on a vacant corner lot after staff raised the merger doctrine regarding common ownership of the adjacent two-family parcel.
